paragraphs: INFORM makes optimization software, and its aviation line sells to operators who want to streamline ground operations while reducing costs and holding service quality. One solution area covers gates, stands and fixed airport resources such as baggage belts and check-in counters.

Another handles ground handling resources, supporting the planning, scheduling, allocation and analysis of ground staff and equipment. A third is aimed at aircraft turnaround, mitigating delays and costs with better turnaround management. A newer tool lets frontline managers at airlines or ground handling companies allocate tasks on the apron or within the terminal.

The company says it has spent over 50 years solving complex business problems with mathematical models. It reports over 2,000 active customers, ranging from medium-sized to large corporations. It also states a commitment to ethically responsible AI and sustainable business practices.

quote.text: For over 50 years, INFORM has been engaging in the art of solving complex business problems with mathematical models.
